headline: Best Sunday in eight weeks caps the strongest weekend since mid-October
commentary:
### The weekend
- Weekend cleared **$9,240 NP**, best in four weeks and six times the last one.
  - NP: $9,240 v $1,435 previous weekend
  - NM: 16.0% v 3.8%
- More leads and better ones, which is the combination we want.
  - Sold: 3,488 v 2,698 previous weekend
  - Search EPL: $25.32 v $20.74
- Sunday on its own was the best in at least eight weeks.
  - Sunday NP: $4,906 v $4,187 eight-week high
  - Sunday EPL: $17.44 v $15.48 average
### Friday
- Friday took $10,193 NP on a lot more spend than 30/10.
  - NP: $10,193 v $5,446
  - Cost: $62,453 v $44,415
- We bought more clicks, slightly cheaper, and sold them better.
  - Search clicks: 5,050 v 3,334
  - Search CPC: $10.96 v $11.48
  - Search EPL: $24.95 v $22.44
- Impression share up too, so we were leaning in all day.
  - Impression share: 12.5% v 11.0%
### What drove it
- Sunday was **lead value, not volume** — same leads, same money out.
  - Processed: 1,338 v 1,326 Sunday average
  - Cost: $18,423 v $18,462 Sunday average
- Search did it, and the click price barely moved.
  - Search EPL: $27.88 v $23.46 last Sun
  - Search CPC: $10.39 v $10.13
- Every tree improved, so it isn't one whale carrying the day.
  - Direct (Inc ZP) EPL: $24.39 v $22.00 last 7
  - Test tree EPL: $21.69 v $20.31
- Evening hours paid for everything; the small hours were dead weight.
  - 19:00 EPL: $58.20 on 123 clicks
  - 01:00-04:00 EPL: $6.31 to $10.70
### Tests
| Test | Set-up | Spend 08/11 | Spend wk ago | Change |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| personal tROAS | 137% to 128% | $234 | $81 | — |
| competitor tROAS | 152% to 130% | $466 | $374 | — |
- Personal tripled its Sunday spend on nine clicks at a steep price.
  - personal CPC: $26.05 v $13.46 last Sun
- Competitor bought a few more clicks, and cheaper ones.
  - competitor CPC: $11.66 v $12.88
watch: Sunday EPL of $17.44 sat just under the eight-week high of $17.78, so we're tracking whether the lead value holds into the week rather than fading back to $15-16.
Personal is paying $26.05 a click since the target cut on 25/09, on tiny volume — we're following whether that click price earns out.
albert.com lost 7.8 points of account impression share week on week; we're keeping an eye on whether that absence is what's holding our CPCs around $10.40.
